spec.head: intent.atis
spec.input: INT8 row-major hidden codes; sorted unique selected segment rows
spec.logits: exact integer dot plus bias; signed 32-bit output, signed 64-bit accumulation
spec.floating_environment: IEEE binary64 round-to-nearest ties-to-even; no fast-math/FMA
spec.failure_payload: label=0; reserved_score=0; only Accepted carries a label
spec.identity: fresh nonzero boot session + strictly increasing nonzero uint64 request ID + contract SHA256
spec.deadline: positive uint32 PL cycles; admission edge age=0; terminal by edge D; matching proposal at D wins
spec.guarantee_scope: stable local terminal record; reset/clock failure and external delivery excluded
spec.deployment_certificate: separate binding of contract, firmware, bitstream, environment and fresh boot session
